breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification states 'The k-point grid must be gamma-centered and have a half shift,' which directly repeats the original contradiction. The ground truth resolved this by removing the gamma-centered requirement and specifying only a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid. The agent failed to eliminate the conflicting gamma-centered instruction.
